records.table_title_as_printed: Tabela 2. Zawartość składników pokarmowych w wybranych komponentach (%)
records.analytical_method: oven drying, muffle furnace ash, Kjeldahl protein, Soxhlet fat, crude fibre by leaching, as described in the article
records.basis_note: The table heads every column '%' without naming the basis. Each row's components sum to less than its dry matter, which fits fresh-matter values, but the article does not say so.
records.sample_count_note: the number of samples analysed is not stated
records.excluded_from_this_record: nitrogen-free extract, which the article calculates by difference and does not tabulate
records.use_limits: One Polish laboratory's analysis of the batches fed in the trial. Not a tortoise digestibility or safety value. The plant part analysed for vegetables is inferred from the common name and the peeling note in the article.
